description: This file defines the `ResendClient` class, a minimal client for interacting with the Resend email API. It contains methods to initialize the client with API key retrieval and to send emails asynchronously via HTTP POST requests.

classes.name: ResendClient
classes.description: A client for sending emails through the Resend API, supporting configuration via environment variables and providing an asynchronous email sending method.
